signup.password-dont-match: Confirmation password must be the same of password.
signup.terms-not-accepted: You must accept the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy to register.

reset.token-not-found: Invalid or expired token, please try again.
reset.email-sent: An email with a link was sent, click to reset password.
reset.success: Password changed, login with the new password.

delete.email-sent: A confirmation email has been sent. Click the link to confirm account deletion.
delete.token-not-found: Invalid or expired token, please try again.

two-factor.setup-not-started: Start setup for this method before confirming a code.
two-factor.wrong-code: That code didn't work. Check it and try again.
two-factor.not-enabled: Two-factor authentication isn't enabled on this account.
two-factor.unknown-method: That two-factor method isn't available on this deployment.
two-factor.not-delivered: That method doesn't send codes — read it off your device instead.
two-factor.email-unverified: Confirm your email address before using it as a second factor.
two-factor.already-enrolled: That method is already armed on this account.
two-factor.resend-too-soon: A code was just sent. Wait a moment before asking for another.
two-factor.method-added: That second factor is now armed.
two-factor.method-removed: That second factor has been removed.
two-factor.backup-codes-regenerated: Your backup codes have been regenerated. The old ones no longer work.
two-factor.challenge-invalid: This login attempt has expired. Please sign in again.

verify.email-sent: A verification email has been sent, click the link to confirm your address.
verify.token-not-found: Invalid or expired token, please try again.

verify-request.subject: Confirm your email address
verify-request.intro: Please confirm that this email address is yours.
verify-request.cta: Click this link to verify your email address.
verify-request.ignore: If you did not create this account, you can safely ignore this email.

reset-request.subject: Password reset
reset-request.intro: We received a request to reset your password.
reset-request.cta: Click this link to set a new password.
reset-request.ignore: If you did not request this, you can safely ignore this email.

setup-request.subject: Set up your account
setup-request.intro: An administrator created an account for you. Choose a password to complete your registration.
setup-request.cta: Click this link to set your password.
setup-request.ignore: If you weren't expecting this, contact whoever manages this site.

delete-request.subject: Confirm account deletion
delete-request.intro: We received a request to permanently delete your account.
delete-request.cta: Click this link to confirm account deletion.
delete-request.ignore: If you did not request this, you can safely ignore this email.

delete-confirm.subject: Your account has been deleted
delete-confirm.body: Your account has been permanently deleted.
delete-confirm.farewell: We're sorry to see you go. If this was a mistake, please contact support.

inactivity-warning.subject: Your account has been inactive
inactivity-warning.body: We haven't seen you sign in for a while. To keep your account, sign in within the next {{days}} days — after that it will be deactivated, and eventually permanently deleted.

two-factor-code.subject: Your sign-in code
two-factor-code.intro: Here is the code to finish signing in:
two-factor-code.ignore: If you weren't signing in, ignore this email and change your password.

oauth.invalid-state: This sign-in attempt has expired. Please try again.

addresses.not-found: The requested address was not found
